aub_can_upgrade_to_sacred_pool_02_trigger = {
	# vanilla can_construct_potential
	has_building_or_higher = temple_citadel_01
	has_dlc = "All Under Heaven"
	# vanilla can_construct_showing_failures_only
	building_requirement_tribal = no
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				culture = {
					has_cultural_parameter = may_build_sacred_pools_ahead_of_time
				}
			}
		}
		scope:holder.culture = {
			has_innovation = innovation_city_planning
		}
	}
	trigger_else = {
		culture = {
			has_cultural_parameter = may_build_sacred_pools_ahead_of_time
		}
	}
}
